name: Grid Autosport
developer: Codemasters / Feral Interactive (macOS, Linux, iOS, Android & Nintendo Switch)
publisher: Codemasters / Feral Interactive (macOS, Linux, iOS & Android)

locations.note: The Touring discipline trailer was shot here with BTCC drivers; the GP, Indy and Drift layouts can each be raced in reverse and at night.
Open Wheel IndyCar-style races run here on the GP and Sportscar layouts, both reversible and both available for night racing.
V8 Supercars such as the Holden VF Commodore and Ford FG Falcon race the mountain in the Touring discipline, forwards or reversed, in daylight only.
Open Wheel IndyCar-style races use the venue, which has five layouts: the oval plus the Sport, GP, Infield and North road circuits.
The GP, National and Club layouts can each be driven in reverse, and the circuit is one of the tracks offered for night racing.
An Endurance venue, where career races run into the night; the GP, North and South layouts can each be driven in reverse.
The GP, South and North layouts can each be driven in reverse; unlike most of the permanent circuits, it is raced in daylight only.
An Endurance venue raced at night, with seven layouts from the full GP circuit to the short Paddock loop and two drift courses.
A Street discipline city track on mostly real streets, with Grand Prix, Sprint and Short layouts and a B variant of each.
A Street discipline city track whose six routes are named for the Arc de Triomphe, Champs-Élysées, Trocadéro, Pont de l'Alma, Avenue de New-York and the Seine.
A Street discipline city track with six routes, among them Jumeirah Beach, Al Sufouh Strip, Nakheel Vista and Gulf Approach.
